title: Content Moderation Chain
summary: This module provides a chain for moderating text content using OpenAI's moderation API, detecting and handling policy violations based on configured rules.

nodes.label: Input Text
nodes.title: Input Text for Moderation
nodes.description: The text content provided by the user or another system to be checked for policy violations.

nodes.label: OpenAI Moderation Chain
nodes.title: OpenAIModerationChain
nodes.description: The core chain responsible for orchestrating the content moderation process using OpenAI's API. It initializes the OpenAI client and manages the moderation flow.

nodes.label: API Configuration
nodes.title: OpenAI API Key & Client Setup
nodes.description: Handles the validation and setup of the OpenAI API key, organization, and client instances (sync/async), ensuring compatibility with different OpenAI package versions.

nodes.label: OpenAI Moderation API
nodes.title: External OpenAI Service
nodes.description: The external service provided by OpenAI that performs the actual content moderation checks on the input text.

nodes.label: Evaluate Moderation Results
nodes.title: Moderation Result Processing
nodes.description: Analyzes the moderation response from the OpenAI API to determine if the content is flagged. Raises an error or returns a warning based on configuration.

nodes.label: Moderated Output Text
nodes.title: Final Moderated Output
nodes.description: The final text after moderation, which is either the original text (if safe) or an error/warning message (if flagged and configured to return one).

groups.label: Surface I/O
groups.title: User-Facing Input/Output
groups.description: Represents the entry and exit points for text content within the moderation process.

groups.label: Core Moderation Logic
groups.title: Central Processing Unit
groups.description: Encapsulates the main chain and the logic for evaluating moderation results.

groups.label: External Integration
groups.title: OpenAI Service Interaction
groups.description: Handles communication with the external OpenAI Moderation API.

groups.label: Configuration
groups.title: API Setup and Parameters
groups.description: Manages the necessary API keys and client initialization for secure and functional operation.
